name: Themes
author: VanillaGreen
description: Choose themes and wallpapers for your desktop and supported applications.

placement.label: Panel position
placement.description: Where the panel opens when you use its shortcut

setWindowBorders.label: Apply theme borders
setWindowBorders.description: Use the theme's window borders and shadows unless your Hyprland settings override them

setCornerRadius.label: Apply theme corners
setCornerRadius.description: Use the theme's rounded window corners unless your Hyprland settings override them

setWindowAnimations.label: Apply theme animations
setWindowAnimations.description: Use the theme's window animations unless your Hyprland settings override them

browserTheming.label: Browser theming
browserTheming.hint: Apply theme colours to Chromium, Chrome, Edge and Brave after setup
